Backup
Everything you set up here (settings, fleet, pastes, tab setups, hunter list) lives only in this browser, and clearing site data wipes it. A backup file keeps it safe and moves it to another browser. Logins and kill history are never in the file (kill history is per character; keep it with Export CSV on the Kill tracker).
Snapshot prices: Fuzzwork market aggregates for Jita IV-4 (station 60003760). Order books and daily history: EVE Swagger Interface. History volumes are for all of The Forge, not just Jita 4-4, and are averaged over calendar days (days with no trades count as zero).
Fees: sales tax 7.5% base, minus 11% per Accounting level; broker fee 3% base, minus 0.3% per Broker Relations level, before standings. Upwell structures set their own broker fee, so use the override there. New orders are priced to 4 significant figures.
Thin market: no trades in the last 7 days, or the best buy order is under 30% of the 7-day average. Those numbers are greyed and never ranked above a real market. Compressing needs a compression service (a Upwell structure or a ship module). Reprocessing tables come from CCP's static data. Click any number for the full market dossier. Not affiliated with CCP Games.
Where to mine: systems, belts and stargates from CCP's static data (Fuzzwork dump); kills and jumps for the last hour from ESI; mining-ship losses from zKillboard, fetched only when you open a system.
Where to rat: bounty ISK per region from CCP's Monthly Economic Report; hourly kill and jump history from EVE Ref; sovereignty and incursions from ESI; rat factions from a community table and recent zKillboard NPC kills. bzip2 decoding by bzip2.js (antimatter15, LGPL), loaded from jsDelivr.
Kill tracker: base rat bounties from CCP's static data (dogma attribute 481). If you log in, your wallet journal is read with EVE's own login (scope: read character wallet) and kept in your browser only.
